title: UV irradiation alters TFAM binding specificity and compaction of DNA
authors: Dillon E. King; Emily E. Beard; Matthew J. Satusky; Alex George; Ian Ryde; Caitlin Johnson; Emma L. Dolan; Yuning Zhang; Wei Zhu; Hunter Wilkins; Evan Corden; Susan K. Murphy; Dorothy Erie; Raluca Gordân; Joel N. Meyer
one_liner_zh: 该文研究UVC损伤DNA对线粒体转录因子TFAM结合特异性和DNA压缩的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，但未涉及AI或物理模拟方法，主要依赖实验手段，故评分为6。
abstract: Mitochondria lack nucleotide excision repair; however, mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) is resistant to mutation accumulation following DNA damage. These observations suggest additional damage sensing or protection mechanisms. Transcription Factor A, Mitochondrial (TFAM) compacts mtDNA into nucleoids and binds differentially to certain forms of DNA damage. As such, TFAM has emerged as a candidate for protecting mtDNA or sensing damage. To examine the possibilities that TFAM might protect DNA from damage or act as a damage sensing protein for irreparable forms of mtDNA damage, we used live-cell imaging and HeLa cell-based assays, atomic force microscopy (AFM), and high-throughput protein-DNA binding assays to characterize the binding properties of human TFAM to ultraviolet-C (UVC) irradiated DNA and the cellular consequences of UVC irradiation. Our cell data show increased TFAM mRNA after exposure and suggest an increase in mtDNA degradation without a loss in mitochondrial membrane potential that might trigger mitophagy. Our protein-DNA binding assays indicate a reduction in sequence specificity of TFAM following UVC irradiation and a redistribution of TFAM binding throughout the mitochondrial genome. Our AFM data show increased compaction of DNA by TFAM in the presence of damage. Despite the TFAM-mediated compaction of mtDNA in vitro , we do not observe any protective effect of increased TFAM protein on DNA damage formation in cells or in vitro . Increased TFAM protein did not alter levels of mtDNA damage over time after UVC exposure in vivo , but knockdown of TFAM did alter mtDNA damage levels in HeLa cells both at baseline and after UVC exposure. Taken together, these studies indicate that UVC-induced DNA damage alters TFAM binding and promotes compaction by TFAM in vitro . We hypothesize that that TFAM may act as a damage sensing protein in vivo , sequestering damaged genomes to prevent mutagenesis by facilitating removal or suppression of replication.
abstract_zh: 线粒体缺乏核苷酸切除修复机制；然而，线粒体DNA（mtDNA）在DNA损伤后仍能抵抗突变积累。这些观察结果表明存在额外的损伤感知或保护机制。线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）将mtDNA压缩成核仁结构，并差异性地结合某些形式的DNA损伤。因此，TFAM已成为保护mtDNA或感知损伤的候选因子。为了探究TFAM可能保护DNA免受损伤或作为不可修复形式mtDNA损伤的损伤感知蛋白的可能性，我们使用活细胞成像和HeLa细胞实验、原子力显微镜（AFM）以及高通量蛋白质-DNA结合实验，来表征人TFAM对紫外线C（UVC）照射DNA的结合特性及UVC照射的细胞后果。我们的细胞数据显示，暴露后TFAM mRNA水平增加，并提示mtDNA降解增加，但未伴随可能触发线粒体自噬的线粒体膜电位丧失。我们的蛋白质-DNA结合实验表明，UVC照射后TFAM的序列特异性降低，且TFAM结合在整个线粒体基因组中重新分布。我们的AFM数据显示，在存在损伤的情况下，TFAM增加了DNA的压缩程度。尽管TFAM在体外介导了mtDNA的压缩，但我们未观察到增加TFAM蛋白对细胞或体外DNA损伤形成有任何保护作用。增加TFAM蛋白并未改变UVC暴露后体内mtDNA损伤水平随时间的变化，但敲低TFAM确实改变了HeLa细胞在基线和UVC暴露后的mtDNA损伤水平。综合来看，这些研究表明UVC诱导的DNA损伤改变了TFAM结合，并在体外促进了TFAM介导的压缩。我们假设TFAM可能在体内作为损伤感知蛋白，通过促进损伤基因组的移除或抑制复制来隔离受损基因组，从而防止突变发生。
